title: eludite.debug.processes output
description: The candidates for eludite.debug.attach: this machine's processes, and the pages of the browser Eludite runs (brief 0038).

parent.description: The parent process's id, when known.

name.description: The program's name (`dotnet`, `mono`, `sh`), from its command line or the process table.

command_line.description: The command line, its arguments separated by spaces (an argument with a space in double quotes), cut at 500 characters (ending with `…`). Empty when it cannot be read.

runtime.description: What runs it, from its command line: `dotnet` (`dotnet` running a `.dll`), `mono` (run by `mono`), `native` (anything else), `netfx` (a .NET Framework program on Windows) or `unknown` (the command line cannot be read).

launched_by_eludite.description: Eludite started it in this session (Start Debugging or Start Without Debugging), or it is a child process of one it started.

debugger_agent.description: For a Mono program started with `--debugger-agent=...,server=y`: where the agent listens (`127.0.0.1:55555`), which eludite.debug.attach connects to. Absent for a Mono program without one, which cannot be attached.

total.description: How many processes matched the filter.

tabs.description: The tabs of the browser Eludite runs (the Web Browser window's, or the external Chrome's), attachable with eludite.debug.attach's `tab` (vscode-js-debug); the Attach to Process dialog lists them under a Web Browser heading. Absent while no browser runs.

session.description: The debugging session attached to it, when one is.
